test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **From.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is** From.**** **
 
• **From **is commonly used to suggest that something stems from something else, that something comes from somewhere, or that something comes from someone.
 
• Thus the correct answer is **Form.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **From** can also be combined with the prepositions 'to' and 'till' to indicate the beginning and end of an action or state.

 
 
• ***I played tennis from two to four in the afternoon yesterday. ***
 
• ***We are meeting in Chicago from Monday until Thursday.***
